(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (apply-cmd grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (rotate-ccw grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (define (sep-col? c)
      (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) 9)) (range 0 (rows g))))
    (define (split-panels)
      (let loop ([c 0] [panels (list)])
        (cond [(>= c (cols g)) (reverse panels)]
              [(sep-col? c) (loop (+ c 1) panels)]
              [else
               (let scan ([stop c])
                 (if (or (>= stop (cols g)) (sep-col? stop))
                     (loop (+ stop 1)
                           (cons (subgrid g 0 c (- (rows g) 1) (- stop 1)) panels))
                     (scan (+ stop 1))))])))
    (let* ((panels (split-panels))
           (a (first panels))
           (b (second panels))
           (c (third panels))
           (code (first (filter (lambda (k) (equal? (apply-cmd (crop-to-content a) k)
                                                    (crop-to-content b)))
                                (range 1 7)))))
      (apply-cmd (crop-to-content c) code))))
